tasks.short: Maintain accurate laboratory records and data

steps.what: Capture actual experimental observations and verify existing instrument files, sample identities and protocol versions before record assembly
inputs: Scientist's actual experimental observations
Actual instrument-generated files and existing sample and protocol records
outputs: Checked source files and scientist-captured observations linked to actual samples

steps.what: Map checked instrument and sample fields into a staged laboratory notebook entry while preserving raw-file links and provenance
inputs: Checked files, sample identities and captured observations from s1
Lab-owner-approved field and identifier mappings
outputs: Staged notebook entry with exact source links and mapping exceptions

steps.what: Draft and edit the notebook narrative from actual captured observations without inventing methods, outcomes or interpretations
inputs: Actual scientist-captured observations from s1
Staged entry and checked source links
outputs: Draft laboratory narrative with source references

loop.purpose: Express actual observations in the notebook's required narrative form
loop.input: Scientist-authored observations and checked source-linked entry
loop.output: Draft prose preserving actual facts and explicit uncertainty
loop.check: Scientist checks every fact, omission, sample identity and source link in s4
loop.stop: Missing observation, conflicting source or new inferred result returns to scientist; no notebook commit
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative synthesis needs meaning; structured instrument and identity fields are transferred exactly in s2

steps.what: Resolve mapping exceptions and check the complete final notebook entry, observations, sample identifiers and raw-data links against actual sources
inputs: Complete draft notebook entry and exceptions
Actual observations, raw files and sample records
outputs: Final checked laboratory entry and data links

steps.what: Commit the exact final checked entry and data links in the same electronic laboratory notebook
inputs: Final checked entry and data links
outputs: Saved accurate laboratory record with raw-data provenance

tasks.design: Configure staged instrument-to-notebook transfer in the laboratory {OPS_SYSTEM}, followed by bounded narrative drafting from actual scientist observations. The scientist checks the complete entry and provenance before a separate commit, without changing raw instrument files.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instrument fields and source references may be copied into notebook records and actual observations rewritten into prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing notebook import functions and bounded source-based drafting can remove repeated transcription and first-draft wording.
tasks.still_hard: Reliable observations, correct sample identity and deciding whether an apparent result is scientifically credible.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist knows what actually occurred and can detect omissions or misleading records.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated laboratory record assembly while retaining actual capture and complete verification.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; laboratory and data owners approve raw-file access, mappings and permitted draft inputs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: electronic laboratory notebooks can import instrument metadata and source links, and a bounded model can draft narrative from supplied observations for scientist review.

assumptions: Instruments produce actual files; the scientist captures non-instrument observations and checks sample and protocol identity in s1. No free transcript, clean sample map or new experimental result is assumed.
The lab owner supplies actual mappings; missing identifiers, unsupported formats or conflicting sources stop affected entries for manual resolution.
s2 replaces actual repeated transfer into the notebook, not an existing equivalent instrument link. The model cannot choose procedures, infer results or write raw data.
Illustrative gross saving 39.5 per 100 task hours, upkeep 4, net 35.5; same-notebook commit earns no gain. Count shared capture and import with tasks 16813 or 16805 once.
unknowns: Actual instrument-to-notebook re-entry and permitted narrative-draft use
research_questions: Which actual instrument fields and source links are copied into the notebook today?

already_counted.description: Capture and verify actual sources, review narrative and check the complete notebook entry

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings and review draft fidelity and notebook exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Complete notebook entry and raw-data links checked in s4; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured repeated-record scenario; actual observation capture, source verification and final checks retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design experiments, oversee execution and interpret results

steps.what: Design the actual molecular or cellular experiment, defining its hypothesis, controls and interpretation criteria within the laboratory's approved scope
inputs: Actual scientific question and supplied evidence
Laboratory-approved research scope and constraints
outputs: Scientist-authored experimental design and criteria

steps.what: Prepare and check the actual working design record using existing approved protocol headings and experiment identifiers
inputs: Scientist-authored design
Existing approved protocol and notebook structure
outputs: Checked working design record for the actual authorized experiment

steps.what: Oversee actual authorized laboratory execution, check deviations and capture and verify the real result sources and experiment identities
inputs: Actual authorized experiment and approved laboratory procedures
Actual staff work and instrument results
outputs: Observed execution, captured deviations and checked result files

steps.what: Import checked result fields and provenance into the specified comparison view using exact existing experiment mappings
inputs: Actual checked result files and identities from s3
Scientist-approved comparison specification and exact mappings
outputs: Staged source-linked result comparison and mapping exceptions

steps.what: Check actual comparison results and deviations, interpret findings against the design and write and check the final scientific interpretation
inputs: Actual source-linked result comparison and exceptions
Original design, controls and observed deviations
outputs: Final checked interpretation and limitations

steps.what: Save the final checked experimental interpretation in the same laboratory record
inputs: Final checked interpretation and source links
outputs: Saved experiment interpretation

tasks.design: Reuse approved design-record fields in {DOCS} and {OPS_SYSTEM} and stage checked result fields into the comparison view in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The scientist retains experimental design, actual oversight and interpretation, including writing and checking the actual result record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated record setup and transferring actual results into a comparison view can add handling effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing templates and exact result-import mappings can reduce that handling without selecting experiments.
tasks.still_hard: Valid controls, interpreting biological variability and recognizing execution problems.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist judges what experiment is justified and what actual results support.

ambition.what: Reduce bounded record and result-transfer work while retaining design and oversight.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4; laboratory and platform owners approve actual protocol scope, source access and mappings

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory templates and exact result imports can reduce record handling while scientific design, oversight and interpretation remain expert work.

assumptions: The scientist authors actual design and comparison criteria and oversees only experiments already within the laboratory's actual authorization. No new procedure, operating condition or experimental scope is generated.
Actual staff and instruments produce results; s3 counts oversight, deviation capture and source verification. Missing source identity or mapping conflicts stop affected comparisons.
s4 replaces actual repeated result entry into a separate comparison view, not existing instrument runtime. If this is the same import as task 16807, count it once.
Illustrative gross saving 11.5 per 100 task hours, upkeep 2, net 9.5; actual interpretation and same-system save remain retained and no experiment or result is automatically released.
unknowns: Actual result-transfer effort and current comparison-view linkage
research_questions: Which result fields are transferred again after laboratory records already contain them?

already_counted.description: Prepare and check the working design record and interpret, write and check actual findings

incremental.description: Maintain approved design fields and exact comparison mappings

approvals.approved_version: Final experimental interpretation and source links checked in s5; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured design-and-interpretation episode; only repeated record setup and actual result transfer reduced after upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve and check the actual funder call, application template and institutional grant-writing requirements
inputs: Actual supplied funder call and institutional requirements
outputs: Checked application requirements

steps.what: Develop the actual scientific research argument, study approach and source-supported preliminary-evidence account for the application
inputs: Actual scientific question
Actual checked lab findings and supplied literature
Actual call requirements
outputs: Scientist-authored scientific argument and checked evidence references

steps.what: Prepare and check actual staffing, resource, timetable and budget inputs with institutional rates and real partner commitments
inputs: Actual proposed research scope
Actual institutional rates and supplied partner commitments
outputs: Checked resource and budget facts with unresolved commitments marked

steps.what: Assemble exact institution and investigator details, actual publication metadata and checked project and budget facts into the funder's template
inputs: Actual institution-approved profile and publication records
Checked project and budget facts from s3
Actual application template
outputs: Factual application skeleton and missing-field exceptions

steps.what: Draft and edit application narrative from the scientist's actual argument, checked lab evidence and project facts
inputs: Scientist-authored argument and actual checked evidence
Factual application skeleton
outputs: Draft application narrative with source pointers

loop.purpose: Express the scientist's actual grant argument in the funder's requested narrative structure
loop.input: Scientist-authored argument, permitted checked evidence and actual project facts
loop.output: Draft narrative preserving supplied evidence and commitments
loop.check: Scientist checks all claims, results, references, numbers and commitments against actual sources in s6
loop.stop: Unsupported result, missing source or invented commitment returns to scientist; no final application
loop.why_not_simpler: Scientific narrative needs semantic drafting; exact factual blocks are assembled deterministically in s4

steps.what: Correct and check the complete final grant application against the actual call, scientific evidence, budget and institutional approval status
inputs: Complete application
Actual call, scientific sources and budget facts
outputs: Final checked application version with actual approval status

steps.what: Save the final checked grant application in the same institutional working-document workspace
inputs: Final checked application version
outputs: Saved grant application

tasks.design: Assemble actual application facts in {DOCS} using checked {SPREADSHEET} inputs, then draft only the scientist's own argument and evidence account. The scientist checks the complete application before saving it with its actual approval status; no funder submission is hidden.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated factual copying and first-draft wording can add effort after the scientific plan and budget are defined.
tasks.enabler_now: Application templates and bounded source-based drafting can reuse actual lab and institutional facts.
tasks.still_hard: A credible scientific proposal, defensible preliminary evidence and feasible commitments.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist owns the research argument and can judge what the actual evidence supports.

ambition.what: Reduce application assembly and wording effort without generating research claims.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; research office and laboratory owners approve confidential inputs and drafting access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: factual grant templates and bounded language-model drafting can assist a scientist-authored application for complete source-based checking.

assumptions: The scientist develops the actual argument and verifies real preliminary findings in s2; s3 counts budget and commitment preparation. Institutional owners supply actual profile records and missing fields remain unresolved.
Only actual permitted evidence enters the helper; no restricted reviewer material, confidential third-party proposal or patient-level record is assumed available.
s4 replaces currently manual application-field assembly; equivalent existing template functions earn no new gain. The model never invents a result, citation or promised collaboration.
Writing an application is separate from institutional approval and funder submission; any actual later approval must concern this final version before its own gated send.
Illustrative gross saving 28 per 100 task hours, upkeep 4, net 24; same-document save earns no gain.
unknowns: Actual factual-assembly workload and institutional drafting permissions
research_questions: Which institutional and lab evidence fields are copied repeatedly into applications today?

already_counted.description: Check call, develop actual science and budget, review narrative and verify the complete application

incremental.description: Maintain approved factual mappings and review source fidelity of drafts

approvals.approved_version: Complete application and actual approval status checked in s6; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured application-writing episode; actual science, evidence and costing work and full final checks retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.short: Perform laboratory procedures under approved protocols

steps.what: Retrieve and check the current approved protocol and sample-specific work instructions for the authorized laboratory procedure
inputs: Existing approved protocol and actual sample work order
outputs: Checked current authorized protocol and sample identity

steps.what: Check actual samples, materials, equipment readiness and required laboratory authorization before beginning the procedure
inputs: Actual samples and materials
Approved protocol and existing laboratory requirements
outputs: Actual readiness confirmed or procedure held

steps.what: Perform the actual authorized laboratory procedure, such as DNA sequencing, cloning or extraction, RNA purification or gel electrophoresis, following the approved protocol
inputs: Actual prepared samples, materials and equipment
Current approved laboratory protocol
outputs: Actual procedure outputs and observed deviations

steps.what: Capture and check the actual procedure completion, observations and deviations in sample-linked notebook fields
inputs: Actual procedure outcomes and deviations
Existing checked sample and protocol identifiers
outputs: Final checked procedure record

steps.what: Save the final checked procedure record in the same laboratory notebook
inputs: Final checked procedure record
outputs: Saved actual procedure record

tasks.design: Configure current-protocol links and sample-linked completion fields in the existing laboratory {OPS_SYSTEM}. Actual readiness checks, laboratory procedures and observation capture remain human; no procedure parameters or instrument controls are generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated protocol retrieval and sample-identity entry can add small record-handling costs.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing notebook and sample links can reduce those repeated operations.
tasks.still_hard: Actual laboratory technique, sample integrity and recognizing deviations.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist performs and observes the real procedure under the laboratory's approved process.

ambition.what: Reduce bounded protocol lookup and repeated record fields while retaining laboratory work.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; laboratory owner confirms approved protocol, sample access and record fields

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: laboratory notebook systems can link approved protocols and sample identifiers to procedure records.

assumptions: The laboratory supplies actual approved protocols and sample work orders; s1 checks version and identity and s2 counts physical readiness. No new experimental method or operating instruction is proposed.
The scientist captures actual outcomes and deviations in s4; no free instrument result, transcript or automatic claim of completion is assumed.
This procedure record overlaps task 16807 if that task maintains the same entry; count shared capture and final saving once. Existing equivalent sample links earn no new gain.
Illustrative gross saving 2.4 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1, net 1.4. Physical procedure work and same-system save have no new saving.
unknowns: Actual protocol navigation and repeated sample-field effort
research_questions: Does the existing sample work order already link the correct protocol and completion record?

already_counted.description: Check actual protocol and capture and check procedure observations

incremental.description: Maintain current-protocol links and sample-linked record fields

approvals.approved_version: Complete actual procedure record checked in s4; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured physical-procedure episode; only bounded lookup and repeated identity fields reduced after upkeep, actual bench work retained.

reach: Coordinate exact sample and instrument mappings with laboratory and data owners and preserve raw-data provenance.
skills_to_grow: Verify actual source and protocol identity
Check bounded scientific drafts against evidence
Retain scientific design and interpretation responsibility
role.ambitious_version: A molecular and cellular biologist who transfers and documents actual findings with less repeated entry while retaining experimental design, authorized bench work, oversight and scientific judgment.
